svg.title: Background
svg.desc: Computer engineer with a Data Science background from Politecnico di Torino. Experience at GFR Engineering, AROL and OVERACE GROUP.
svg.text: I'm a computer engineer with a background in Data Science
from Politecnico di Torino. I connect industrial systems, data pipelines
and software to turn machine data into useful information.
Built a web SCADA / IIoT platform for remote compressor
monitoring, from Modbus acquisition to dashboards and alarms.
Applied industrial AI and anomaly detection to production data,
with time-series analysis, feature extraction and reporting.
Worked on vehicle CO2 monitoring, Python / Pandas pipelines
